label: Version 1.5.4
releaseNotes: Uploads send each file exactly once per server. The same server, account, and folder selected twice is skipped, not sent again.
A new Upload results list shows every server as Passed, Failed, or Skipped with the reason and how long it took.
LEIE files picked up immediately by the server's inbound folder now count as delivered instead of failed.
A server that stalls or cannot be reached is stopped and the next server starts right away, so a run no longer waits on one server.
Retry Failed Uploads checks the server first and never re-sends a file that already arrived.
Every generated Referral Number is exactly 12 characters including the prefix and stays unique across the batch. Custom prefixes are limited to 8 characters.
Archive names no longer end in _Final, and the combined JSON file name can be edited.
Updated Electron, the installer builder, and other dependencies to patched releases.
Smaller current-dates control with a short label and helper text.
Manifest files are optional: use Generate Manifest after a completed job.
Payment Authority Code dropdown options show only the numeric code.
Payment Authority Code now uses the searchable SEOC-style dropdown with saved selections.
New referrals default to current dates; expiration follows Referral Period and custom dates remain available.
Master JSON uses consistent readable formatting and naturally ordered filenames.
Payment Authority Codes now come from the team reference list, with 43 unique codes and no automatic incrementing.
Referral Number choices are VA and Custom; ICN choices are Default, Custom, and Referral Number.
Keep individual formatted JSON, a combined formatted master JSON, or only gzip. Generate a manifest separately when needed.
Repeated runs overwrite matching filenames after validation and preserve unrelated files.
Stations, Networks, payment codes, and SEOC pairs stay within approved selections; selecting all clears selected subsets.
Referral and LEIE uploads use one sequential queue, skip duplicate destinations, and continue after a failed server.
Dialogs scroll on smaller screens and at higher zoom so confirmation buttons remain reachable.
The Setup installer distinguishes a fresh installation from an upgrade in the selected folder.
Updated Electron and Playwright; added output validation and batch regression coverage.
teamHighlights: Reliable uploads: each file goes to each server exactly once, and a stalled or unreachable server no longer holds up the run.
Clear results: a new Upload results list shows every server as Passed, Failed, or Skipped with the reason.
LEIE uploads: a file picked up right away by the server's inbound folder now counts as delivered, and Retry Failed Uploads never sends a second copy.
Referral Numbers: always exactly 12 characters including the prefix, and unique across the batch. Custom prefixes can be up to 8 characters.
Simpler names: archive names no longer end in _Final, and the combined JSON file name can be edited.
Maintenance: Electron and other dependencies were updated to patched releases.
